title: Bird Strike Management Risk Assessment
description: Free Bird Strike Management Risk Assessment template for aviation you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers bird/wildlife hazard management information, bird strike risk assessment matrix, bird strike severity classification

Bird Strike Reporting And Investigation

REPORTING PROCEDURE:

1. Pilot reports strike to ATC

2. ATC notifies airport wildlife manager

3. Strike location marked and inspected

4. Feather/remains collected for identification

5. ICAO bird strike report form completed

6. Data entered into national/international database

7. Analysis for trends and patterns
